common.networkRetry: Check your network connection and try again.

login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in to continue your study plans and answer history.
login.switchDescription: All in-flight requests on the current connection are aborted and the local session is cleared; exams on the original server are not paused.
login.switchNote: Answers that were not saved are not transferred to the new server and are not uploaded to the original server.
login.passwordChangedNote: Please sign in again with your new password.

connect.title: Connect a study server
connect.description: The service identity and protocol version are verified first; your credentials are only sent after you confirm.
connect.addressHint: A deployment path prefix and HTTP/HTTPS are supported. With HTTP the data is not encrypted, so deploy only on trusted networks; ignoring certificate errors is not offered.
connect.trust: I confirm the address above is the study server I want to connect to, and I understand that a service marker does not replace checking the address and transport security.
connect.verifyOkDesc: The Drill Hub service marker and the compatible API major version were confirmed.
connect.connectFailed: Could not connect to the server

password.title: Change password
password.description: Verify your current password and set a new password used only for Drill Hub.
password.newHint: The password must be at least 4 characters long; do not reuse it for other services.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
password.notice: After a successful change, sessions on this and other devices become invalid; sign in again with the new password.

archive.title: Archived resources
archive.description: Archiving does not delete answer, grading or wrong-question history. Restoring a parent resource does not restore independently archived child resources.
archive.emptyDesc: No archived resources match the filter. The first version offers no permanent deletion, so no fake recycle bin items appear here.
archive.restoreNote: New study actions are possible after restoring; existing history and links stay unchanged.
archive.restoredDesc: The resource is available again and its history is unchanged.
archive.invalidResponse: The server returned an invalid archive response format
archive.invalidRecord: An archive record has an invalid format
archive.unknownType: An archive record contains an unknown resource type
archive.missingId: An archive record is missing its resource identifier
archive.planMissing: The server could not find this archived plan, so it cannot be restored safely
archive.missingRevision: The question archive record did not return expectedRevision, so restoring was stopped to avoid overwriting concurrent changes. The backend must add revision to the archive list contract

users.title: Account management
users.description: Create standalone study accounts, enable or disable access and reset passwords. The first version has no public registration and no default administrator password.
users.createDesc: The administrator sets the initial password; the user can sign in with it directly and change it later. Do not pre-set passwords in code or on the page.
users.disableDesc: Access is restricted by the server immediately; learning data and history are not deleted.
users.enableDesc: Once enabled, the user can sign in to their learning space again.
users.resetDesc: A new password will be generated for「{name}」and the current password stops working immediately.
users.secretDesc: The full password is shown only once. Share it with the user over a secure channel after closing.
users.createFailed: Could not create the study account
users.statusFailed: Could not update the account status
users.resetDoneDesc: Deliver the one-time temporary password securely.
users.resetFailed: Could not reset the account password
users.missingPassword: The server did not return a one-time temporary password

grading.title: Grading operations
grading.description: Only redacted task states and safe error codes are shown; there is no cross-user answer browsing and scores cannot be changed here.
grading.empty: No grading tasks match the filter
grading.emptyDesc: Studying and submitting do not depend on this page. After fixing the configuration you can explicitly resume failed or blocked tasks here.
grading.retryDoneDesc: The task is back in the grading queue.
grading.retryFailed: Could not resume the grading task

tokens.title: Agent access
tokens.description: Manage the access tokens of external agents.
tokens.emptyDesc: Create a token to let an agent you trust access your account.
tokens.createDesc: All permissions are granted by default and can be adjusted. Only hand the token to agents you trust.

field.name: Token name
field.namePlaceholder: For example: my study plan assistant

tokens.expiresHint: Leave empty for no fixed expiry.
tokens.editDesc: Permissions for「{name}」change immediately after saving. The secret, name and expiry stay the same.
tokens.revokeDesc: 「{name}」takes effect immediately and is permanently deleted. No token record is kept and it cannot be restored.
tokens.secretDesc: Save it in your password manager or a controlled agent configuration; you can copy it again from the access list later.
tokens.createUnavailableDesc: Enter a token name and select at least one permission.
tokens.createdDesc: Store it safely; you can copy it again from the access list later.

tokens.scopeFailed: Could not update the agent token permissions
tokens.revoked: The agent token was revoked and deleted

tokens.copyFailed: Could not copy the agent token

scope.contentWrite: Create and adjust topics, plans and content
scope.assessmentWrite: Create and adjust practice and exams
scope.attemptWrite: Void answer records (a reason is required)

scope.gradeWrite: Submit rubric levels for externally graded questions

usage.title: Token usage
usage.description: Track the cost of model grading so every study session is measurable.
usage.scopeHint: Includes today and is split by day using the device time zone {timezone}
usage.empty: No model calls in this period
usage.emptyDesc: Once a model grading finishes, the actual usage appears here. Rule-based grading and external agent grading do not create model calls on this site.
usage.dailyDesc: Only tokens reported by the provider are counted; calls with unknown usage do not raise the bars.
usage.noteP1: Only model grading and model capability tests started by this site's server are counted; every retry and re-grade counts separately. Provider connection tests and model list reads are not counted, and model usage by external agents is out of scope.
usage.noteP2: Tokens come from provider responses and are not estimated from text length. A failed call may already have consumed tokens; when no complete valid usage is returned it is recorded as unknown usage rather than zero. Historical calls are not back-filled, this page is not a provider bill, and it does not estimate costs.

models.title: Providers and models
models.description: Manage grading service connections, model identifiers and the default grading profile in one place. Providers and models are not hard-coded, and secrets are never echoed back.
models.separationTitle: Configuration is separated from grading facts
models.separationDesc: Connection tests carry no real user answers; model tests use synthetic questions. A new configuration only affects new tasks and never re-grades history or changes scores.
models.loadFailed: Could not load the system configuration
models.emptyProvidersDesc: Add a protocol adapter implemented by the server, a controlled API address and a secret reference. Test the connection after saving, then verify the rubric output model by model.
models.modelsDesc: Prefer automatic discovery through the provider {'/models'} endpoint; you can also maintain model IDs manually and run a grading test per model
models.modelLoadFailed: Could not load the model list
models.noModelsDesc: You can discover models from the provider {'/models'} endpoint or enter model IDs manually.
models.profilesDesc: Pick a model and set concurrency, timeout and retries; the default profile only applies to new tasks
models.noProfilesDesc: First add a model under the current provider, then create a default grading profile. Without one, studying and submitting still work and model questions stay pending.
models.noUsableModels: This provider has no enabled model, so no grading profile can be created.
models.connectionDesc: You can test the address and secret you entered first; testing does not save anything. The old secret is never echoed, and leaving it empty keeps it unchanged.

field.apiUrlHint: The server applies an outbound address policy, so this cannot be used to probe arbitrary internal services.
field.apiKeyHint: Secrets are never echoed and never appear in public server-info or on study pages.
field.discoveryFilterPlaceholder: Filter by model name or ID
field.setDefaultProfile: Set as the new default grading profile

models.discoverDesc: Read models from the provider {'/models'} endpoint; existing models are not created twice, and each imported model still needs its own grading test.
models.modelIdDesc: Enter the model identifier the provider actually supports; it still has to pass a synthetic rubric test afterwards.
models.profileDesc: Only enabled and verified models can be used. Saving creates a new profile version and does not change existing tasks. Concurrency limits how many grading tasks a profile runs at the same time.

models.modelListError: Could not load the model list

models.testFailed: The connection test did not pass
models.connectionCreatedDesc: Test the connection first, then discover or add models manually.
models.connectionSavedDesc: A new configuration version was generated.
models.connectionSaveFailed: Could not save the provider connection
models.connectionTestOkDesc: The server confirmed the connection and authentication; you still have to verify the grading capability per model.
models.noModelsReturned: The provider returned no usable models
models.noModelsReturnedDesc: You can still add model IDs manually.
models.allAddedDesc: The provider returned {count} models and all of them already exist in this connection.
models.discoverFailed: Could not fetch the provider models
models.importedDesc: {count} models were added; run a grading test for each of them.
models.modelAddedDesc: Run the synthetic rubric test for it.
models.modelStateFailed: Could not update the model status
models.modelTestFailed: The model grading test did not pass
models.modelTestDoneDesc: Check the verified configuration version before using it for default grading.
models.profileModelError: Could not load the grading models
models.profileSavedDesc: Existing grading tasks stay bound to their profile; the default profile only applies to new tasks.
models.profileSaveFailed: Could not save the grading profile
models.setGradingModelDesc: New tasks use this model while existing tasks keep their configuration.
models.setGradingModelFailed: Could not set the grading model
models.defaultSwitched: The default grading profile was switched
models.defaultSwitchedDesc: It only applies to new grading tasks.
models.defaultSwitchFailed: Could not switch the default grading profile

audit.title: Audit logs
audit.description: Review recorded business actions, API access and sign-in results. Visible to administrators only; the logs are read-only.

searchHint.audit: Action, resource type, resource ID or account
searchHint.api: Route, request ID, account, IP or error code
searchHint.login: Account, request ID, IP or error code

audit.emptyDesc: Adjust the filters; API and sign-in logs only exist from the moment this feature was enabled.
audit.noteP1: Action audit shows recorded business events without free-text summaries or user answers. API logs cover this site's API requests using route templates and store no query string, request body, response body, cookie or access token.
audit.noteP2: Sign-in logs cover success, failure, malformed input and rate-limit results for Web and Android sign-ins; unknown usernames are not echoed. The IP is the direct peer address and forwarding headers are not trusted. History is not back-filled, and there is currently no deletion or automatic cleanup.
audit.invalidRange: The end time must be later than the start time

assistant.title: Built-in Assistant Settings
assistant.deleteDescription: Delete "{name}"? The assistant will lose access to it. This cannot be undone.
assistant.searchHint: The assistant uses search providers to query the web; only the first enabled provider takes effect.
assistant.baseUrlHint: Leave blank for the official endpoint; required for SearXNG / OpenAI Responses
assistant.apiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the current key
assistant.secretKeepHint: Saved secrets are never echoed; leave blank to keep them unchanged.
assistant.mcpHint: stdio servers spawn child processes on the server; only add trusted sources and keep them disabled by default. Private http addresses are rejected.
assistant.skillHint: Skills are injected as SKILL.md instructions; names use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
